templates.name: Clear Race
templates.rule: Be first to clear two layers.

templates.name: Build Race
templates.rule: Build to the line while clears are off.

templates.name: Shape Race
templates.rule: Fill the same two-layer target before your rivals.

templates.name: Survival
templates.rule: Keep building; the last player standing wins.

templates.name: Hole in the Wall
templates.rule: Rotate your block so its silhouette fits the approaching hole.

templates.name: Copycat
templates.rule: Remember the model, then rebuild it with the same blocks.

templates.name: Colour Rush
templates.rule: Pop matching flavours; chains send grey garbage to rivals.

templates.name: Perfect Stack
templates.rule: Release each sliding block and keep every cube supported.

templates.name: Crane Tower
templates.rule: Release swinging blocks and hold your tower above the line.

templates.name: Mascot Bridge Race
templates.rule: Build a walkway that takes your mascot to the far flag.

templates.name: Box Packers
templates.rule: Fill every cell in your box and send awkward blocks.

templates.name: Gift Exchange
templates.rule: Clear four layers while choosing blocks to gift your rivals.

templates.name: Speed Sort
templates.rule: Swipe each block into its matching colour bin.

templates.name: Shadow Duel
templates.rule: Build a stack that matches both silhouettes exactly.

templates.name: Memory Tower
templates.rule: Build from memory as your locked blocks fade from view.

templates.name: Spin Cycle
templates.rule: Clear layers while your tower turns every three locks.

templates.name: Floor Is Lava
templates.rule: Keep a half-full safe layer above the rising lava.

templates.name: Hot Block
templates.rule: Clear the smoking block to pass it before its fuse expires.

templates.name: Catch Tower
templates.rule: Slide the tray under the falling blocks to grow your tower.

templates.name: Rhythm Blocks
templates.rule: Hit the matching lane as each seeded block reaches the beat.

templates.name: Magnet Maze
templates.rule: Move and reverse polarity to pull every block into a dock.

templates.name: Balloon Volley
templates.rule: Return the block in its flight window to score against rivals.

templates.name: Gem Grab
templates.rule: Collect gems on the block island and deposit your bag.

templates.name: Paint Dash
templates.rule: Walk the block island and paint the exposed stencil faces.

templates.name: Balance Budget
templates.rule: Choose and place blocks so both pans balance to earn a rack.

templates.name: Block Bowling
templates.rule: Aim, add spin and roll your block to knock down the cube pins.

templates.name: Simon Stack
templates.rule: Watch the pads light up, then repeat the whole sequence.

templates.name: Quick Drop
templates.rule: Tap the instant the block turns green, but never before.

templates.name: Cube Count
templates.rule: Count every cube in the tower before it disappears.

templates.name: Odd Block Out
templates.rule: Spot the one block that is a mirror twin, not a turn.

templates.name: Toy Pairs
templates.rule: Flip two cards at a time and match every pair of blocks.

templates.name: Block Dodge
templates.rule: Step between lanes to dodge the falling blocks.

templates.name: Slide Shuffle
templates.rule: Slide the tiles back into the picture of the block.

templates.name: Mirror Mirror
templates.rule: Paint the mirror image of the pattern on the other side.

templates.name: Colour Count
templates.rule: Count the blocks of the target colour in the parade.

templates.name: Whack-a-Block
templates.rule: Tap the blocks as they pop up, but leave the bombs alone.

templates.name: Tower Pull
templates.rule: Pull bars from your tower without letting it topple.

templates.name: Spin Match
templates.rule: Turn your block to match the target in as few turns as you can.

templates.name: Plinko Drop
templates.rule: Drop your block through the pegs into the best bucket.

templates.name: Treasure Dig
templates.rule: Dig the patch and follow the hot-cold numbers to the buried block.
